_note: Key shape error.<ErrorCode>.<impact|dataRetained|retryAction|billing|scoring>, matching the 21 values of openapi components.schemas.ErrorCode and the five-part error rule in SCREEN-SPEC section 4. Written in English, not machine translated.

unauthorized.impact: Your session expired, so this action did not run.
unauthorized.dataRetained: Everything you typed on this page is still here.
unauthorized.retryAction: Sign in again and you will come back to this page.
unauthorized.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

forbidden.impact: This account cannot access that content, so the action did not run.
forbidden.dataRetained: Your data stays in your account.
forbidden.retryAction: Check which account you are using, or ask your organisation administrator for access.
forbidden.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

not_found.impact: We cannot find that item. It may have been deleted.
not_found.retryAction: Go back to the list and pick again.
not_found.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

conflict.impact: Someone or something changed this item just now, so your submission did not apply.
conflict.dataRetained: Your input is still on this page.
conflict.retryAction: Refresh to see the current state, then submit again.
conflict.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

validation_failed.impact: Some fields do not meet the requirements, so nothing was submitted.
validation_failed.dataRetained: All of your input is kept, and focus moved to the first field that needs attention.
validation_failed.retryAction: Fix the highlighted fields and submit again.
validation_failed.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

upload_rejected.impact: The file was rejected and never entered parsing.
upload_rejected.dataRetained: The job description you pasted and your other input are fully kept.
upload_rejected.retryAction: Swap in a different file as described, then upload again.
upload_rejected.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

scan_retryable.impact: The file security scan did not finish this time.
scan_retryable.dataRetained: Your original file and your input are both kept.
scan_retryable.retryAction: Retry this step later. You do not need to upload again.
scan_retryable.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

parse_retryable.impact: The parsing service is briefly unavailable, so this step did not finish.
parse_retryable.dataRetained: Your original resume and job description are both kept.
parse_retryable.retryAction: Retry only the failed parsing step, or switch to editing the fields yourself.
parse_retryable.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

sensitive_content_rejected.impact: The material contains content that never enters an interview, so that part was rejected.
sensitive_content_rejected.dataRetained: The rest is kept, and the excluded field categories are listed on the page.
sensitive_content_rejected.retryAction: Adjust the material and submit again.
sensitive_content_rejected.scoring: Excluded content never becomes scoring evidence.

low_confidence_unresolved.impact: Some low-confidence fields are still unconfirmed, so you cannot move on yet.
low_confidence_unresolved.dataRetained: The parsed result and your edits are both kept.
low_confidence_unresolved.retryAction: Review the highlighted fields, confirm them, then continue.
low_confidence_unresolved.scoring: Only confirmed fields enter the interview context.

idempotency_conflict.impact: This action was already accepted, so it did not run a second time.
idempotency_conflict.dataRetained: The result of the first attempt stands and was not overwritten.
idempotency_conflict.retryAction: Refresh to see the result of the first attempt.
idempotency_conflict.billing: You will not be charged twice.
idempotency_conflict.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

rate_limited.impact: Too many requests in a short time, so this action did not run.
rate_limited.dataRetained: Your input is still on this page.
rate_limited.retryAction: Wait for the cooldown to end, then try again.
rate_limited.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

risk_verification_required.impact: A security check is needed before you can continue.
risk_verification_required.dataRetained: Your input is still on this page.
risk_verification_required.retryAction: Finish the check, then submit again.
risk_verification_required.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

verification_invalid.impact: That code is not correct, so sign-in did not complete.
verification_invalid.dataRetained: The email address you entered is kept.
verification_invalid.retryAction: Enter the code again, or send a new one once the cooldown ends.
verification_invalid.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

verification_expired.impact: That code has expired, so sign-in did not complete.
verification_expired.dataRetained: The email address you entered is kept.
verification_expired.retryAction: Send a new code and enter it again.
verification_expired.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

identity_conflict.impact: That identity already belongs to another account, so the link was not created.
identity_conflict.dataRetained: Neither account was merged or changed.
identity_conflict.retryAction: Sign in with the original account, or contact support to sort it out.
identity_conflict.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

provider_unavailable.impact: An external service we depend on is briefly unavailable, so this action did not finish.
provider_unavailable.dataRetained: Your existing data and evidence are fully kept.
provider_unavailable.retryAction: Try again shortly. The system also retries on its own.
provider_unavailable.scoring: This is not a failure, and existing scores are untouched.

region_mismatch.impact: This request targets a different data region than your account, so it did not run.
region_mismatch.dataRetained: Your data stays in its own region. No cross-region access happened.
region_mismatch.retryAction: Use the entry point for your account's data region.
region_mismatch.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

insufficient_entitlement.impact: There are not enough credits, so this round did not start.
insufficient_entitlement.dataRetained: Your project and plan are fully kept.
insufficient_entitlement.retryAction: Top up credits, then start the round.
insufficient_entitlement.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

state_conflict.impact: The current state does not allow this action, so it did not run.
state_conflict.dataRetained: Frozen plans and scoring evidence are untouched.
state_conflict.retryAction: Check the current state and available actions shown on the page, then act.
state_conflict.scoring: No effect on any score or unlock status.

internal.impact: The service hit an internal error, so this action did not finish.
internal.dataRetained: Data you already submitted and your scoring evidence are fully kept.
internal.retryAction: Try again shortly. If it keeps failing, contact support with the request ID.
internal.scoring: This is not a failure, and existing scores are untouched.
